job.job_description:
Role Summary

We are looking for an AWS GenAI Engineer to design, build, and scale Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions on AWS. The role involves working across LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, MLOps, and cloud-native architectures, enabling enterprise-grade AI use cases such as copilots, intelligent assistants, document intelligence, and AI-powered automation.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop Generative AI solutions on AWS using managed and open-source LLMs
Build RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines using enterprise data sources
Develop AI agents and copilots for business, engineering, and operations use cases
Integrate LLMs with applications, APIs, and enterprise systems
Implement prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and model optimization strategies
Operationalize GenAI solutions using MLOps / LLMOps best practices
Ensure security, compliance, and data privacy in AI implementations
Collaborate with architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate use cases into scalable solutions
Support POCs, pilots, and industrialization of GenAI capabilities
Successfully delivered GenAI use cases from POC to production

Core Technical Skills

Generative AI & LLMs

Hands-on experience with LLMs (e.g., Amazon Bedrock models, OpenAI-compatible models, open-source LLMs)
Prompt engineering, prompt chaining, and context optimization
RAG architecture design (embeddings, vector stores, retrieval strategies)
Knowledge of fine-tuning vs prompt tuning vs adapters
Amazon Bedrock (model selection, guardrails, orchestration)
AWS SageMaker (training, inference, pipelines)
AWS Lambda, ECS/EKS, Step Functions
S3, DynamoDB, Aurora / RDS
IAM, KMS, VPC, CloudWatch for secure AI workloads
Experience with serverless and container-based AI architectures
Strong proficiency in Python
Familiarity with LangChain / LlamaIndex / Semantic Kernel
REST APIs, FastAPI, Flask
Experience integrating LLMs with web and enterprise applications
Embeddings and semantic search
Vector databases such as OpenSearch, Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma
Data preprocessing, chunking, and metadata strategies

Nice-to-Have Skills

Agentic AI frameworks and multi-agent orchestration
Integration with RPA / workflow engines
Knowledge of DevOps & IaC (Terraform / CloudFormation)
Experience in manufacturing, enterprise IT, or large-scale transformation programs
Exposure to Copilot-style application development
CI/CD for AI models and prompts
Model versioning, monitoring, observability
Experiment tracking and evaluation
Cost optimization for inference workloads

Education & Experience

Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related fields
4–10+ years of software / cloud engineering experience
2+ years hands-on experience in GenAI / LLM-based solutions preferred
